text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally time for the Arima Kinen, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just as reported, Narita Brian is running 
too. This morning's news covered it as the 
"Showdown of the Strongest Sisters."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, the one who will emerge 
victorious is me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off. To keep the promise I 
made with that girl back then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how long it's been since we last 
stood shoulder to shoulder in a race."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You've grown strong, Brian. The greatest 
Triple Crown Umamusume in history. A true 
'monster.'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, I am her older sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As an older sister who ran ahead of you on 
this stage, I will show you that I can 
defeat you.
